title: Grilled Chicken & Cowboy Salsa
subtitle: with heirloom corn nachos & sour cream
description: This culinary experience is like lassoing a rainbow. A loaded salsa of black beans, fresh tomato, charred corn, avo, pickled pepper, red onion, coriander, & a zesty lemon vinaigrette is served with a juicy chicken breast, sour cream, and crunchy heirloom corn nachos for scooping. It'll have you sayin' "Yee-haw!"

instructions.title: CHARRED CORN
instructions.text: Place a pan (that has a lid) over a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the corn and fry for 3-4 minutes until lightly charred, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan and set aside.

instructions.title: HAVO SOME AVO
instructions.text: Halve the avocado and remove the pip. Peel off the skin and roughly dice. Squeeze over the juice of 2 lemon wedges, season, and set aside.

instructions.title: HOWDY, CHICKY!
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towel. When the pan is hot, fry the chicken, skin-side down, for 4-6 minutes until golden. Flip, pop on the lid, and fry for 3-5 minutes until cooked through. During the final 1-2 minutes, baste with a knob of butter and ⅔ of the spice blend. Remove from the heat and rest in the pan for 5 minutes before slicing and seasoning.

instructions.title: COWBOY SALSA
instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine the juice of 2 lemon wedges, a drizzle of oil, the remaining rub, a sweetener of choice (to taste), and seasoning. In a salad bowl, add the charred corn, the diced tomato, the rinsed black beans, the chopped pickled peppers, the dressed avo, the diced onion (to taste), and ½ the picked coriander. Drizzle over the lemon vinaigrette (to taste) and toss until combined.

instructions.title: PLATE UP!
instructions.text: Plate up the sliced chicken and top with a dollop of sour cream and the remaining picked coriander. Serve with the cowboy salsa and the nachos for scooping. Enjoy, Partner!

chef_tip: If you have some extra time, shred the chicken after it has been cooked and toss it through the salsa!
